name: manual_c69610
claim: When two branches independently append new entries to the same shared, append-only log file (a lessons JSONL/MD file, an audit trail) at the same position, git reports a real content conflict even though both additions are semantically compatible -- resolve by taking the union of both sides (all lines from both), never by arbitrarily picking one side, which silently discards real content.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-22/23: merging origin/main into a lesson-graduation branch produced 4 conflicts in .agent/memory/*; 3 were exactly this pattern (two sessions each graduated their own new lessons at the same file position). Resolved as a union across all three files -- verified JSON/JSONL still parse and repo_hygiene.py still passes after the merge.
